changelog: Fixes a genuine schedule fault: an auto-sized weekly film-night block ("fit block to content") could report the base queue's episode split into two identical-looking back-to-back airings around the block's nominal end, on any occurrence after the first - the episode itself played once, correctly, but the schedule reported it as repeating. Caused by a stale window boundary left over from the block's original (pre-film-length) span; the base queue now looks past it to the real next change once the film has released it back.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
